card.name: Increase/frequency wording before risk or monitoring
card.fires_on: Words like "of" after "frequency", or "increase(s)" after "may" or a drug name, in label sentences about more monitoring or higher risk. It also fires on "multiple" in "multiple myeloma".

modes.label: frequency of
modes.description: The word "of" right after "frequency" when monitoring is being stepped up.
modes.example: Increase the frequency<< of>> INR monitoring if coadministration with war

modes.label: increase the risk
modes.description: The verb "increase" or "increases" after "may" or a drug name, leading into a risk or effect.
modes.example: Metformin may<< increase>> the risk of lactic acidosis in
